kind: analyze (decomposition profiles + residual extremes from staged LOCPOTs + upstream context)
provenance: profiles and extremes from 3_reproduction/L4/decomposition_vs_y.csv (run 20260604_li_L4_opus_think, corrected-L2 analytic columns)

conventions.potential_sign: phi = -LOCPOT (the stored LOCPOT value is the potential energy of an electron). Stated in the prompt; every DFT profile below carries this sign. Note the sibling L1_analyze unit reads the stored value itself, so the two units use opposite readings of the word 'potential' and each prompt states its own.
conventions.step_extraction: Continuum geometry is the declared sine mid-surface and parallel monolayer offsets +/-1.625 angstrom along its upward normal. Each profile is indexed by its own Cartesian y coordinate. Use x averaging and a uniform 4 angstrom straight tangential average at each normal offset; fit each side over 4.5..9 angstrom and -9..-4.5 angstrom, and subtract extrapolated intercepts at s=0, top minus bottom.
conventions.curvature: Signed curvature of the declared sinusoidal bilayer continuum mid-surface z_c(y)=L_z/2+9 angstrom*sin(2*pi*y/L), positive where z_c second derivative is positive. The agent derives curvature; the standard curvature formula is not supplied.

grid.rule: y_j = j*L/24, j = 0..23 (pinned in the prompt); the submitted y_over_L must match j/24 within 0.01 each

profiles.note: PRIMARY: each of the 24 points within max(10% of |truth|, the profile's floor = 10% of its largest |value|). The six arrays score everything the prompt asks for against our reference: the DFT extraction (dVn, dVfl_I, dVfl_II), the residual (dVsl), and the analytic model (dVfl_an = V0*kappa, dVsl_an = the L1 map at the L2 nu_ac). Nothing is self-graded; the rms/max agreement deviations are recomputed by the grader from the submitted arrays and recorded as diagnostics only. The extraction geometry and the fit window are pinned in the prompt (see `conventions`); the reference arrays retain the canonical historical extraction. An independent implementation of the declared continuum observable agrees within the existing tolerances. Historical extraction used fitted surfaces, discrete tangential averaging over 7 angstrom and a median across five vacuum windows.

consistency.rule: dVsl_V[j] = dVn_V[j] - dVfl_I_V[j] - dVfl_II_V[j] within max(0.002 V, sum of the four independent decimal rounding radii). Radii use original JSON decimal exponents, preserving trailing zeroes. Physical reference tolerances are unchanged.

residual_extremes.note: PRIMARY (within max(10% of |truth|, floor 0.01634 V)): extremes of the DFT residual over the 24 samples. NOT derivable from the upstream csvs (which give only the analytic ~0.132 V); our historical DFT residual is ~23% larger; the individual contributions of finite-cell, functional, geometry and extraction effects have not been isolated, so an L1-guessed 0.132 fails dVsl_min.

sign_changes_per_period.rule: exact integer: cyclic count ignoring samples with |dVsl| < 0.02 V (the threshold is stated in the prompt; the raw unthresholded count is 4, from a sub-0.01 V wiggle at the y=0 node)

diagnostics.note: recorded, NOT scored: the grader recomputes the agreement deviations FROM THE SUBMITTED ARRAYS (flexo = dVfl_I/II vs dVfl_an pooled; total = dVn vs 2*dVfl_an + dVsl_an; sliding = dVsl vs dVsl_an). Ours, for calibration:

score: 1 only if all six 24-point profiles, the y_over_L grid, the dVsl arithmetic consistency, both residual extremes, and the sign-change count pass (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0)
